pcs.pc_description: identify the raw materials for making the pattern and mold
arrange the different tools and equipment at the workplace
ensure raw material are as per product requirement both in terms of quality and quantity
identify the appropriate amount of cardboard pulp and glue (form of leather) based on the job specifications
arrange the suitable synthetic water colors and polish as per the product requirement required for coloring the objects
arrange galvanized iron wires of appropriate size and dimensions required for making the skeleton of toy based on the approved job specification
place appropriate quantity of water in a drum based on the job specification
place eyes, teeth and soles of an appropriate size and numbers required for making leather toy
deliver the remaining raw material to the appropriate storage locations
explain the importance of wrapping galvanized wires of mild steel or iron of 1mm to 4mm thick depending upon the size of the toy skeleton

apply standard operating procedures while using the solution of cardboard pulp in the appropriate ratio of 1:20 of the cardboard powder
arrange the suitable type of leather with an appropriate thickness of 0.6mm to 0.8 mm in skins and 1mm to 1.25mm in hides depending upon the job specification
select synthetic water color based on the standard finishing sheet and mix with water in an appropriate proportion depending upon the job sheet
perform the appropriate cleaning procedures to clean the tools and equipment after their use to prevent color spots, stains and rust
demonstrate the inspection process based on the quality standard parameters to ensure the appropriate thickness and surface finishing is being achieved
demonstrate the steps to be followed while maintaining records of inspection results/tests. ensure that there is no wastage of the materials
prepare a sample format /template to collect information during inspection based on color, polish, cardboard pulp and quality of leather
achieve periodical targets set by the supervisor
identify the different types of parameters required to ensure the appropriate amount of inventory is being stored at the time production

modules.module_title: carry out the process of making wire frame

pcs.pc_description: identify the tools and equipment to be used for the preparation of the product in accordance to the specifications provided
apply the standard operating procedures to make the wire frame structure based on thickness and materials used for making the final product
perform the process of wrapping the grass and strands in the form of bunches with appropriate thickness of threads to build the mass on the skeleton
demonstrate the standard operating procedures to make the cardboard crushed and moistened for further processing
perform the standard mixing procedures for mixing the moistened and crushed cardboard pulp with tamarina flour
perform the process the tanning process on leather material for preserving through putrefaction to avoid any loss to the properties of leather
apply standard operating procedures for wrapping the leather material on the skeleton based on thickness and skin type based on the job specification
arrange the materials eyes, teeth, soles and nails along with appropriate colors and sizes from 1/4th of an inch to 2 inch depending upon the size of the toy

modules.module_title: carry out the process of smoothening and finishing

pcs.pc_description: perform the standard operating procedures to place the finishing objects on the final prepared product ensuring the correct dimensions and sizes are there
select the suitable color combinations and the appropriate quantity of wax polish based on the job specification
apply standard organizational safety procedures while using sulphate oxides, synthetic colors, wax polish and sharp tools and equipment
select the appropriate quantity of glue for sticking leather over the model body by boiling tamarind powder
perform the standard organizational procedures for making the surface smooth and finished by using a rubbing stone over the wet leather
demonstrate the visual inspection on the product made to check the joints, edges, surface finishing and smoothness
place the product in the sunlight for drying the wet leather for minimum 10 to 15 days
perform the process of weighing the final product and make the record of consumption of raw materials used for making the final product
